# Brownfield Scenario (SCN-B) Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the SCN-B requirements (custom aliases on the existing shortener) cover impact analysis, change control, regression and rollback.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the brownfield baseline defined as a specific, reproducible version (git tag `shortener-baseline-v1`, release R0) with the change chain to R2? [Clarity, PD-009; ADR-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is impact analysis required before any change, with its contents enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-B-AC1, §FR-ORC-010] [D13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is change-control approval required before implementation, bound to the change-set fingerprint? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-B-AC2, §FR-ORC-033] [D14] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is rollback on failed validation specified, together with the restored state and its evidence? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-B-AC4, §FR-ORC-035] [D17] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is detection of changes outside the approved impact analysis specified, with the blocking outcome? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-B-AC5; policy-set.v1.yaml CHG-002] [D13] [D14] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are custom alias rules complete (charset, 4–10 length, reserved words, conflict outcome)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-SHR-020, §FR-SHR-021; ADR-014] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are rollout and rollback considerations required in the impact analysis, specific to the SCN-B change? [Coverage, Spec §SCN-B-AC1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the SCN-B contract increment (1.2.0) specified with its migration class? [Completeness, contracts/README.md] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the method for identifying impacted components specified (registry plus import graph), together with its known blind spots? [Clarity, Plan §11.2; ADR-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the regression scope specified (which pre-existing tests must pass)? [Clarity, Spec §SCN-B-AC3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "requests without an alias are unchanged" made measurable by naming the tests that define unchanged behavior? [Measurability, Spec §FR-SHR-022] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the deliberately defective variant specified with its labeling and expected outcome (FAILED, R1 intact)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-036; PD-012] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the rule that change sets may not add or change dependencies stated with its rejection outcome? [Clarity, ADR-006; Human Gate 4 ruling 3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the conditional G-SECURITY trigger for SCN-B defined objectively (the security-sensitive registry flag)? [Clarity, PD-007] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Is a change-set integrity mismatch specified with its outcome? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; policy-set.v1.yaml CHG-001] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
